description.html: HabiStat Reptavite is a comprehensive vitamin and mineral supplement, formulated to balance the diet of reptiles and amphibians that eat vegetables, fruit, meat or fish. It contains vitamins A, D3, E, C and K3, B-group vitamins, brewer's yeast and minerals (zinc, manganese, copper) in glycinate form.

The manufacturer recommends it for iguanas, herbivorous lizards and tortoises. Reptavite can also be used instead of Repton for dusting insects when a lower-potency supplement is needed, and for dipping whole food items such as mice or rats before feeding.

Manufacturer's instructions: lightly sprinkle on greens or vegetables, or lightly dust insects, every 4th feed. A quarter of a teaspoon is enough. Store in a cool, dry place and reseal the pouch after use. For animal use only.
Reptavite does not replace calcium: between vitamin days, use a calcium supplement such as HabiStat Pure Calcium and provide UVB lighting. You will find all of these in our equipment range.
